verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own docs show an opt-in user data directory that persists cookies and local storage across runs, which gives users some control over whether browser data is retained. Nothing documents deletion controls or retention settings for the server-side cache of act/observe/extract results, and Browserbase contexts and regional data residency are host-platform features. missing for 10: documented retention periods or deletion/purge controls for server-side cached results, explicit data-deletion APIs or settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
